To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a method for embedded software development on top-of-transaction-level-models that makes the development of the software much easier and also reduces the effort needed for the creation of the transaction-level model.
the proposed HPC concept allows SW developers to access HW services as remote methods on the TLM level and that the effort to develop the TLM infrastructure is reduced by our proposed method.
we propose a concept for HPCs on top of transaction level models, which makes embedded software development easier and also helps in the development of the transaction level model itself.
In summary, our research is concerned with
embedded SW development on top of a TLM model.
the question how to make embedded SW development more efficient by exploiting the advantages of TLM-based HW/SW co-design.
the development of an HPC protocol and its implementation on top of transaction level communication.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of HPC is beneficial to embedded SW development on top of a TLM-based SoC platform.
HPC is a promising concept to improve embedded SW productivity in SoC development.
HPC is an efficient and promising concept that allows to significantly improve the productivity in embedded SW development on top of TLM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HPC enables a higher-level, more intuitive, and less error-prone SW development process on top of TLM.
HPC enables a more productive embedded SW development process on top of a transaction-level model.
HPC enables early embedded software development on top top of a transaction-level platform.
The main takeaway from our work is that
transaction-level models should be designed in such a way that they are not only suitable for hardware verification but also for embedded software development.

the HPC concept can be used to provide a high-level abstraction for embedded software development, and that the concept is not restricted to transaction-level modeling but can be extended to any other interconnect.
HPC is an effective approach to enable SW developers to work on transaction-level models.
